summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a share consolidation, creation of a new Class C share with 90 votes per share, and a massive increase in authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$18,720,000. The consolidation ratio is 6:1, effective June 22, 2026. The proposals were approved by large majorities. This is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation event such as a tender, going-private, or activist campaign.
